title: The Essence Weaving System
content: Magic in the Sundered Realms operates through the manipulation of elemental essences that flow through ley lines. Practitioners must attune to specific essences (Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Spirit, Shadow) and risk corruption if they draw too heavily from forbidden sources. The Council's ban stems from the Cataclysm of Ages past, when uncontrolled magic nearly tore reality apart.
